l3_edits.old: Boys dancing with even-indexed girls swap positions with boys who are dancing with odd-indexed girls. That is the one who was dancing with the girl 1 swaps with the one who was dancing with the girl number 2, while the one who was dancing with girl number 3 swaps with the one who was dancing with the girl number 4 and so one.
l3_edits.new: The boys swap simultaneously across position pairs (2,3), (4,5), ..., (n,1), where each position is the index of the girl they currently dance with.

original_sample_explanations: Replaced together with samples because logical mutation may invalidate their answers or explanations; original source retains them.
